objective: Add a derived LifeUp RPG execution surface and remote Northflank MCP path without displacing any existing Ron OS truth owner, live owner, permission gate, provenance or recovery capability.

roles_before.artifact: BOOTSTRAP.md + references/domain-routing.md + existing domains/*.md owners and claim-specific live owners
PROTOCOL.md authority table: Ron direct execution report or stronger direct execution record
TickTick/Calendar and claim-specific domain live owners remain authoritative by claim
Ron OS rule that credentials/account secrets do not belong in continuity files

role_dispositions.destination: LifeUp is explicitly derived; every real-world claim continues to route to the existing Ron OS/domain/live owner by claim class.
The registry remains authoritative and explicitly registers projects/lifeup-system.md as a new project owner.
LifeUp gets a thin skill route plus explicit BOOTSTRAP/CURRENT discovery while all existing routes remain present.
LifeUp MCP writes remain subject to the existing exact live-mutation permission gate; BUILDING/read-only setup does not authorize writes.
A LifeUp task being present is not execution; genuine completion may be supporting execution evidence only when it represents Ron's action and no stronger source conflicts.
LifeUp does not absorb or replace TickTick, Calendar, Cronometer, Liftosaur or other existing live owners; cross-domain quests recover their authoritative inputs first.
Base SHA, candidate branch, manifest and Git history preserve rollback/provenance.
Northflank/LifeUp bearer tokens and Tailscale credentials stay in runtime secret stores/local environment and are forbidden from Ron OS files.

capability_probes.assertion: A nutrition/training/finance/current-app question still resolves through its existing skill + owner + live owner rather than through LifeUp state.
A LifeUp quest that exists, is scheduled, or was generated by the System must not be asserted as real execution; mutation is not permitted merely because the System project is BUILDING.
The existing Trendyol print project and all registered domain owners remain discoverable and registered after the LifeUp project is added.
The pre-LifeUp Ron OS architecture remains recoverable from base SHA 0c7ba0046b0cf68c896bdddc4ceef1d25e3476b5 and Git history.
